title: Influence lower bound from Fourier degree
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{\\pm1\\}$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer such that the Fourier degree of the real-valued sign representation of $f$ is at most $k$. For every coordinate $i$, its influence is either zero or at least $2(1/2)^k$.
hypotheses_covered: The Fourier degree of the real-valued sign representation of $f$ is at most $k$
